senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כפף)to bend; part. pass. כָּפוּן bent upon, eager for.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79">Gen. R. s. 79</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Job 5:22">Job V, 22</cite>) <he>זה לבן שבא כ׳ וכ׳</he> that refers to Laban who rushed with eagerness at his (Jacob’s) money to plunder it.
